description: This file defines the internal implementation of the SiloConnection class within Orleans, including connection management, message handling, ping handling, and logging functionalities specifically for silo-to-silo communication in the Orleans runtime.

classes.name: SiloAddress
classes.description: Represents the address of a silo in the Orleans cluster.

classes.name: Connection
classes.description: Base class for managing connections within Orleans runtime.

classes.name: Message
classes.description: Represents messages exchanged between silos, including properties for message metadata.

classes.name: MessageCenter
classes.description: Handles message routing and processing for connected silos.

classes.name: ConnectionOptions
classes.description: Holds configuration options for a connection, like protocol version.

classes.name: ProbeRequestMonitor
classes.description: Monitors incoming probe requests to handle health checks.

classes.name: ConnectionPreambleHelper
classes.description: Helps read and write connection preambles during connection setup.

methods.name: HandlePingMessage
methods.description: Handles incoming ping messages and responds appropriately.

methods.name: FailMessage
methods.description: Handles cleanup or rejection of a message that failed to send.

methods.name: RunInternal
methods.description: Main loop executing read/write preambles and connection management tasks.

methods.name: PrepareMessageForSend
methods.description: Prepares a message before it is sent over the connection, including validation and logging.

methods.name: RetryMessage
methods.description: Retries sending a message, respecting maximum retry limits.
